author: Mark Manson
description:
Going home for the holidays is the fastest way to find out how much work you still have left to do. You can spend years in therapy learning your triggers, then walk through your parents' door and feel all of it slip away before dinner.

Understanding a pattern in your head and acting differently inside it are two separate skills, and the second one only gets built in the room with your family.
title: Your Family Installed Your Buttons
